summary: This section sets out the qualifying period of service required for an employee to claim a statutory redundancy payment. An employee is excluded from the right to receive a redundancy payment unless they meet the statutory threshold for continuous employment. Specifically, the employee must have accumulated at least two years of continuous service ending with the relevant date.

elements.requirement: The individual must have achieved continuous employment for the specified statutory minimum duration.
elements.quote: continuously employed for a period of not less than two years

elements.requirement: The qualifying period of continuous employment must conclude on the statutory relevant date.

thresholds.what: Minimum continuous employment required to qualify for a redundancy payment
